|quest_reward4_type = vendor |quest_reward4_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Cyclone''' is a [[channelling]] [[Melee skill|melee]] [[attack]] [[skill]] that rapidly hits all enemies in a circular area around the player. The player can move while channelling Cyclone. Cyclone can be used with any melee weapon, or while [[unarmed]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== *'''Attack speed''': Cyclone spins at the player's [[attack speed]] and deals damage once per spin. *'''Dual wielding''': Cyclone will alternate weapons while [[dual wielding]]. *'''Area of Effect''': The base radius of Cyclone is 1.6 metre, regardless of the base [[range]] of the wielded weapon(s). This can be scaled by [[area of effect]] modifiers. ** '''Melee Strike Range''': Cyclone gains increased area of effect per 0.1 metre of ''additional'' melee strike [[range]], whether from global modifiers like on {{il|Daresso's Salute}} or local modifiers like on {{il|Atziri's Disfavour}}.{{efn|name=strikerangerename}} While [[dual wielding]], this bonus is halved for range modifiers limited to a single weapon. *'''Movement modifiers''': While channelling, the player is immune to all sources of [[knockback]] and has less [[movement speed]]. {{il|Bear Trap|Bear Traps}} will still stop movement. Characters can pass through enemies for the duration of the attack (this is not considered [[phasing]]). *'''{{il|Multistrike Support}}''': Cyclone (and all [[channelled skill]]s) cannot be supported by Multistrike. When Cyclone is used with {{il|Karui Waverider Effect}}, it causes the Cyclone's area of effect to visually tilt. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Less
Movement
Speed |c1_header = Less Movement Speed |c1_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% less Movement Speed |c1_pattern_value = %d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.27.0| * Now deals 20% more Damage at all gem levels. }} {{Version history table row|3.26.0| * Cyclone: Now has 68.2-125.1% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem levels 1-20 (previously 60.6-111.2%). Now has 30-20% less Movement Speed at gem levels 1-20 (previously 30% less at all gem levels), and 15% increased Area of Effect per 0.1 metre additional Melee Strike Range (previously 10% increased). Quality now provides 0-5% increased Area of Effect per 0.1 metre additional Melee Strike Range (previously 0-10% more Movement Speed). }} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * No longer has Added Attack Physical Damage at all gem levels. * It now has 61% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 44%), scaling up to 111% at gem level 20 (previously 59%). * Now has a Mana cost of 2 at gem level 1, scaling up to 3 at gem level 20 (previously 2 at all gem levels). * The following Skills no longer have the Physical tag: Blade Flurry, Blade Flurry of Incision, Cleave, Cleave of Rage, '''Cyclone''', Cyclone of Tumult, Lancing Steel of Spraying, Perforate, Perforate of Duality, Shrapnel Ballista, Split Arrow, Sweep, Vaal Blade Flurry, Vaal Cleave, and Vaal Cyclone. }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * No longer has "First Hit deals 50% less Damage", "Gain 1 Stage every 0.3-0.2 seconds while Channelling", "Lose 1 Stage every 0.3 seconds while not Channelling, +0.1 metres to radius per Stage, or Maximum 3-6 Stages. It now has 10% increased Area of Effect per 0.1 metre additional Melee Strike Range at all gem levels (previously 8%), and a base radius of 1.6 metres (previously 1.1). * Quality now provides 0-10% more Movement Speed, instead of 0-10% increased Area of Effect. * Alternate quality gems, labyrinth helmet enchantments and unique threshold jewels are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of skills. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called Transfigured Gems that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some. * Transfigured Gems are alternate versions of existing skill gems that have different functionality and balance than their regular versions. We have added many of these, with interesting variations that drastically change how existing skills play. * Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal Quality Gems have been removed from the game. Existing alternate Quality Gems now have the base Quality effect found on the respective Gem. * Many Skill Gems now display their radius in metres in the Gem description. }} {{Version history table row|3.22.1| * Weapon Range displayed on Melee Weapons and other descriptions that use ranges with values now instead use metres. The reminder text for "Close Range" and the description of Presence range in the Character panel also now use metres. }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Now deals 59% of Base Damage, and has 59% this skill's area radius. }} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| *Cyclone's additional attack range per level has been lowered, and now matches the same progression as the other attack skills, gaining Cyclone now also uses pathfinding to determine where the skill will take the player (as opposed to moving in a direct line). Cyclone's description has been updated. * Fixed a bug where stats with the "while stationary" condition would erroneously stay active in certain cases while using Cyclone. }} {{Version history table row|2.1.0| * Attack skills that have their damage based on the wielded weapon have their mana costs fixed in place from level 1 onwards. * There was a display bug that caused Cyclone to show the wrong DPS value and attack speed. We have fixed this bug, so you'll now notice the visual DPS almost double and the attack speed on the gem shoot up a lot. In addition, we have reduced the damage of Cyclone by around 10% and have reduced the damage of its initial hit. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Reduced the mana cost at all levels. It now grants 0.5% increased area of effect radius per 1% of quality (was 1% per 1% quality). }} {{Version history table row|1.3.0h| * Fixed a bug related to Cyclone where its stats could apply for a while after it ended. }} {{Version history table row|1.3.0| * Cyclone now attacks slightly slower and has an equivalent increase to damage. It now deals damage immediately when it is used, in addition to periodic damage. Cyclone no longer targets enemies, only locations. }} {{Version history table row|1.2.1| * We no longer treat Cyclone as a movement skill for the cases of Karui Spirits or flags in Capture the Flag. }} {{Version history table row|1.2.0| * This skill can no longer be supported by the Multistrike support gem. }} {{Version history table row|1.0.2b| * Fixed the skill tooltip damage per second display for Cyclone. }} {{Version history table row|0.11.1| * Melee skills with Damage Effectiveness have been changed to having a "Deals % of Base Damage" stat. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.4| * The damage effectiveness of Cyclone has been increased from 35% to 40%. * We have also reduced the minimum distance it travels, so that you have more control.
